name: OmniGet 0.14.0
body:
## What's New

### BitTorrent Telemetry & Endgame Completion
- Fixed BitTorrent downloads hanging indefinitely at 99% during final piece verification and disk sync.
- Enforced deterministic endgame state transition to 100% upon verified block completion.
- Added dynamic real-time download speed reporting (bps / MB/s) to the torrent progress bar.
- Added live remaining bytes and pending data counters to torrent telemetry views.

### Platform Extractors & Security Hardening
- Skool: Fixed lesson resolution failures caused by Next.js build ID mismatches and route token updates (#94).
- Udemy: Added safe handling for empty course catalogs and zero-item module structures (#72).
- CLI Security: Hardened yt-dlp argument construction against parameter injection vulnerabilities.

### Localizations & System Shell
- Added complete Open Nami localization across all supported language dictionaries (#71).
- Added system tray context menu translation support and fixed tooltip string formatting (#70).

### Architecture & Core Refactoring
- Completely removed the unmaintained Study module, purging all associated routes and database overhead.
- Decoupled Telegram media viewer and video playback components for high-reliability standalone operation.
- Removed maintenance announcements from application home view.
- Formalized dev branch staging and cloud CI quality gates for automated cross-platform verification.

### Dependencies & Toolchain
- Upgraded TypeScript to 5.9.3, hls.js to 1.7.3, and Tauri plugins to latest stable versions.
- Vitest suite (31 files, 183 tests) and documentation E2E suite (60/60 tests) verified at 100% pass rate.

name: OmniGet v0.13.0
body:
# OmniGet 0.13.0 Release Notes

OmniGet 0.13.0 fixes the YouTube audio-muxing bug on 1080p+ videos, updates the Settings UI, adds custom MosCat navigation icons to the sidebar, fixes Facebook video URL decoding, and brings every dependency and security audit to green.

---

## YouTube Stream Muxing & FFmpeg Auto-Download (Fixes #54)

YouTube serves 1080p, 1440p, and 4K video as separate video and audio streams. If FFmpeg was not on the system or not found by yt-dlp, downloads finished as video-only `.webm` files with no sound.

* **Automatic FFmpeg checks**: `core/ytdlp.rs` and `platforms/youtube.rs` now check for FFmpeg before starting any download. If FFmpeg is missing, OmniGet downloads and unpacks it before handing the job to yt-dlp.
* **Mux format**: Added `--merge-output-format mp4` to combine audio and video streams into an MP4 container whenever separate streams are selected.
* **macOS and Linux binary paths**: Desktop launchers (such as macOS `launchd`) do not inherit shell `$PATH` configurations. Added fallback search paths for `/opt/homebrew/bin`, `/usr/local/bin`, `/usr/bin`, and `/bin`.
* **Apple Silicon code signing**: Downloaded binaries extracted to the cache directory on macOS are now signed with `codesign -s - -f` to prevent Apple Mobile File Integrity (AMFI) from terminating processes with `SIGKILL`.
* **Relative path fix**: Fixed `find_ffmpeg_location()` returning an empty string when FFmpeg resolved to a bare relative filename.

---

## Settings UI & Sidebar Navigation

* **Dynamic Settings headers**: `src/routes/settings/+page.svelte` now shows a distinct header, title, and description for each settings tab (General, Downloader, Network, Appearance, and Advanced).
* **Sidebar icons**: Replaced generic icons in `src/components/shell/NavIcon.svelte` with dedicated MosCat SVG assets for Home, Downloads, Marketplace, Tools, OpenNami, and Convert.
* **12-locale translation**: Added translation keys for all new Settings headers across English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Persian, Greek, and Lao.

---

## Facebook URL Extractor Fix

* In `src/lib/open_nami/extractors/facebook.ts`, replaced `JSON.parse` with regex unescaping in `decodeEscapedUrl()`. The old parser crashed on backslashes (`\/` and `\\`). The new implementation unescapes `\uXXXX` unicode sequences and standard control characters directly.

---

## Security & Dependency Updates

* **Svelte 5.57.2**: Bumped from 5.51.0. Brings in six releases of reactivity bug fixes, compiler improvements, and rune fixes.
* **Vite 6.4.4**: Bumped from 6.4.1. Fixes path handling in `launch-editor` on Windows and `server.fs.allow` path checks (CVE-2026-111766, CVE-2026-111758).
* **`devalue` (>= 5.9.4)**: Enforced via `pnpm.overrides` to patch an ArrayBuffer allocation bypass in `@sveltejs/kit` (GHSA-r9w8-h9r3-54w4).
* **`markdown-it` (>= 15.0.3)**: Enforced via `pnpm.overrides` to patch quadratic-time rendering on unclosed link definitions.
* **Dev dependencies**: Updated `@types/node` to 26.6.5 and `@fontsource/dm-sans` to 5.3.0.
* **Security status**: 0 open Dependabot alerts and 0 open CodeQL warnings across the repository.

---

## Test Results

* **Vitest**: 31 test files passed, 177 tests passed (100%).
* **Documentation & routes E2E**: 60/60 tests passed across all 4 tiers (`scripts/e2e_verify.mjs`).
* **Rust unit tests**: 92 tests passed across `omniget-core`.

---

### Debian/Ubuntu users: AppImage compatibility

**Debian 12+ ships without FUSE 2 by default**, which AppImage requires.
If `./omniget.AppImage` fails with a libfuse error, run:

```bash
sudo apt install libfuse2
```

...or use `./omniget.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run`.

**Easier alternative**: download the `.deb` instead, which works out of the
box on Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 22.04+.

---

### macOS users: "OmniGet is damaged and can't be opened"

The app is not notarized with Apple yet, so Gatekeeper quarantines it.
After moving the app to `/Applications`, run:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/omniget.app
```

Then open it normally. If it still refuses, allow it under
**System Settings → Privacy & Security**.

---

### Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). Code changes and signed releases are reviewed and approved by the OpenSelena maintainers. See our [Privacy Policy](https://omniget.nav.bd/docs/#privacy).

name: OmniGet v0.12.0
body:
## What's New

### Telegram Client Authentication & Handshake
- Updated embedded Telegram downloader plugin to official Open Selena application credentials.
- Replaced legacy credentials across MTProto sender pool connection, QR code login authorization, and SMS code verification flows.
- Enhanced connection stability for multi-datacenter media fetching and channel archive synchronization.

### Official Community Migration & UI Polish
- Migrated About page community links from Discord to the official Telegram community channel (`https://t.me/OpenSelena`).
- Added dedicated Telegram paper-plane vector glyph with theme-consistent styling.
- Routed external link activations through Tauri shell plugin handler (`plugin:shell|open`) for desktop system browser execution.

### Content Security Policy & Star Badge Restoration
- Extended webview Content Security Policy with `frame-src 'self' https://ghbtns.com;` to unblock GitHub star badge widgets.
- Restored GitHub star badge iframe rendering on the About Project view while preserving strict script and asset isolation.

## Fixes

- **CSP Frame Directives**: Resolved GitHub star button loading failure caused by restrictive webview frame policy.
- **E2E Test Verification**: Updated test checksum assertions in `tests/tier1_features.mjs` to match the release version bump, ensuring 100% test pass rate across the 57-test documentation test suite.
- **Documentation Parity**: Synchronized release badges, download links, and search modals across all documentation pages and root landing pages.

name: OmniGet v0.11.0
body:
## What's New

### 36 Course Platforms Wired & Platform Dispatcher
- Wired all 36 course platforms to the `download_course_platform` dispatcher, enabling direct course downloads across the entire supported platform catalog.
- Added native authentication and Udemy course listing handlers directly inside `CoursesPlugin`.
- Injected Tauri `AppHandle` into the embedded Courses plugin for background downloads, notifications, and queue state synchronization.
- Resolved zero-course listing fallback and improved session handling for Udemy and Hotmart.

### Security Hardening & Isolation
- **Strict Webview CSP**: Enforced a strict non-null Content Security Policy across all Tauri webview windows.
- **Asset Protocol Scoping**: Restricted custom asset protocol (`asset://`) access strictly to app data, user download, and system temp directories.
- **Scoped Shell Protocol**: Locked down `shell:allow-open` permissions in the default capability to safe protocols (`https:`, `http:`, `mailto:`).
- **Session Protection**: Enforced strict `0600` file permissions on cached authentication tokens and credentials on disk.
- **Header Sanitization**: Sanitized cookie and auth headers against CRLF / control character injection attacks.

### UI Polish & Metadata Standardization
- Updated Windows installer and executable metadata: `productName` is standardized to **OmniGet** and publisher to **OpenSelena**.
- Dynamically resolved version numbering in the About dialog directly from the Tauri runtime.
- Polished footer credits and standardized tab titles and terminology across all 12 localized languages.
- Prevented heap out-of-memory errors during frontend bundling by allocating 4GB memory to the build process.

## Fixes

- **Windows Runner & CI**: Removed unused Windows dependencies in the courses plugin that caused entrypoint crashes during testing.
- **Clippy Baseline**: Resolved unit value bindings and warnings across the Rust codebase for stable CI checks.
- **Homebrew Cask**: Fixed YAML indentation and checksum targeting in the macOS Homebrew release pipeline.

name: OmniGet v0.10.5
body:
## What's New

### Telegram & OmniGram folders
- Telegram media now saves to `{download_dir}/OmniGram/{channel_name}/` instead of dumping into the root download folder.
- Folder names are automatically sanitized for Windows, Linux, and macOS (strips invalid characters and reserved names like `CON` or `NUL`). If the channel folder already exists, downloads save straight into it.
- Fixed `DC_ID_INVALID` errors when downloading media hosted on home Telegram datacenters.

### Embedded plugins
- Statically embedded the `convert`, `telegram`, and `courses` plugins into the app binary so they work immediately without dynamic library errors or duplicate symbol collisions.
- Switched plugin registry URLs to OpenSelena.
- Fixed Kajabi login tokens in the courses plugin, plus resolved a Windows COM string issue with WebView2.

### AI & Media playback
- Added an AI provider picker in Settings > AI.
- Fixed local media playback on Linux (WebKitGTK) and renewed expired stream tokens before playback starts.
- Pointed AppImage builds to system GStreamer plugins so video playback doesn't fail on newer distros.

### Localization
- Finished Russian translation across the UI.

name: OmniGet v0.10.0
body:
## What's New

### OpenNami engine overhaul
- Replaced Open Omni with the OpenNami engine architecture.
- Added dual-engine fallback: if a download stream fails or gets throttled by a host, OmniGet switches to the secondary engine automatically.
- Added anti-bot hardening to handle challenge pages and stream extraction blocks.
- Existing Open Omni configurations, local caches, and download states migrate to OpenNami automatically on first launch.

### In-app announcements and What's New
- Added an announcement modal that surfaces releases, important fixes, and site compatibility alerts directly inside the app.
- Dismissing an announcement records its ID locally so it will not pop up again.

### Languages and typography
- Added Lao (ລາວ) language translation.
- Bundled Noto Serif Lao font so Lao text renders consistently across all operating systems.
- Corrected Persian translations for course attachment descriptions.

## Fixes

- **Course attachments**: Fixed an issue where the toggle to download course attachments was hidden in the settings menu.
- **Linux SQLite compatibility**: Prevented bundled SQLite symbols from clashing with the system `libsqlite3` library on Linux distributions.
- **Windows path handling**: Fixed path separator normalization in yt-dlp template test suites on Windows runners.

body:
## What's Changed

### Added
* Open Omni multi-platform downloader interface with `gallery-dl` and `yt-dlp` backend integration
* Profile manager for authentication cookies, custom output directories, and download presets
* Loop mascot reactive state animations across all download phases
* Embedded offline changelog fallback in application about view

### Upstream Sync & Fixes
* macOS auth cookies: direct WKWebView cookie store extraction to resolve HttpOnly auth sessions (`#287`)
* Fix dependency row process storm when querying binary versions (`#293`)
* Relax updater signature requirement when building from source (`#290`, `#298`)
* Improve command palette action search and navigation shortcuts
* Update Instagram Reel and Bilibili collection parsers
* League of Legends client tools optimizations and UI skeletons

### Architecture & Maintenance
* Standardize application bundle identifier to `com.igect.omniget` across Tauri, Flatpak, and CI workflows
* Automatic data migration from legacy `wtf.tonho.omniget` and `omniget` directories
* Modernize lazy locks with Rust standard library `OnceLock` and `LazyLock`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/igect/omniget/compare/v0.8.11...v0.8.12

name: OmniGet v0.8.11
body:
## OmniGet v0.8.11

### Architecture and Refactoring
- **Platform Extraction Engine**: Consolidated all media extraction engines exclusively into `omniget-core::platforms`, removing over 13,000 lines of obsolete duplicate implementations across 13 providers.
- **Rust Standard Library Modernization**: Migrated all lazy synchronization primitives from the external `once_cell` crate to Rust standard library `std::sync::OnceLock` and `std::sync::LazyLock`.
- **Dependency Reduction**: Removed unused dependencies (`open`, `once_cell`) from workspace Cargo configurations.

### Performance and Reliability
- **Deterministic Identifier Fallbacks**: Replaced static name tables with lightweight, deterministic timestamp-based identifiers in the download queue.
- **Native Internationalization**: Refactored relative time formatting in `timeAgo` to utilize browser-native `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, eliminating hardcoded locale dictionaries.
- **Bundle Optimization**: Removed unreferenced development audit routes and sandbox scaffolding from the production distribution.

---

name: OmniGet v0.8.9
body:
## Downloads

**Windows**: `.exe` installer or portable.
**macOS**: `.dmg` (Apple Silicon `aarch64` or Intel `x86_64`).
**Linux**: `.AppImage` (universal) or `.deb` (Debian/Ubuntu).

---

### Debian/Ubuntu users — AppImage compatibility

**Debian 12+ ships without FUSE 2 by default**, which AppImage requires.
If `./omniget.AppImage` fails with a libfuse error, run:

```bash
sudo apt install libfuse2
```

…or use `./omniget.AppImage --appimage-extract-and-run`.

**Easier alternative**: download the `.deb` instead — works out of the
box on Debian 12+ and Ubuntu 22.04+.

---

### macOS users — "OmniGet is damaged and can't be opened"

The app is not notarized with Apple yet, so Gatekeeper quarantines it.
After moving the app to `/Applications`, run:

```bash
xattr -cr /Applications/omniget.app
```

Then open it normally. If it still refuses, allow it under
**System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
